verdict.rationale: Amplitude Experiment's docs say you can define an experiment or flag audience by user properties (attribute-based rules) and by cohorts or segments (reusable audiences). Flag targeting rules can also reference user properties, including prior assignments, and features can be staged to specific target audiences. Every element of the story is named, but the evidence is brief summary lines rather than detailed rule documentation. Missing for 10: detail on rule operators and the targeting-rule builder, explicit documentation that segments are saved and reused across flags, and independent or hands-on confirmation of targeting behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: to target users by properties, cohorts, or segments
You can reference this user property in another flag's targeting rules to target users based on their previous assignments.
